vm.name: bbdd
vm.exec: mkdir -p /root/.ssh chown -R root:root /root/.ssh chmod 700 /root/.ssh chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys dhclient eth9 || true

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive dhclient eth9 || true apt-get update apt-get install -y openssh-server mariadb-server mariadb-client iproute2 iputils-ping net-tools
# Crear tambien usuario 'adminuser' (UID 1000) con sudo y la misma clave publica SSH id -u adminuser >/dev/null 2>&1 || (groupadd -g 1000 adminuser && useradd -m -u 1000 -g 1000 -s /bin/bash adminuser) echo 'adminuser ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/adminuser chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/adminuser mkdir -p /home/adminuser/.ssh cp /root/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/adminuser/.ssh/authorized_keys chown -R adminuser:adminuser /home/adminuser/.ssh chmod 700 /home/adminuser/.ssh chmod 600 /home/adminuser/.ssh/authorized_keys
# Configurar OpenSSH solo mediante clave publica (sin contrasena) mkdir -p /run/sshd sed -i 's/^#\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config sed -i 's/^#\?PubkeyAuthentication.*/PubkeyAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config sed -i 's/^#\?PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config systemctl enable ssh || true systemctl restart ssh || service ssh restart
# Configurar y arrancar MariaDB escuchando en la interfaz VLAN (10.1.2.100:3306) cp /root/mariadb/50-server.cnf /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/50-server.cnf systemctl enable mariadb || true systemctl restart mariadb || service mariadb restart mariadb < /root/mariadb/init_db.sql

vm.name: logs
vm.exec: mkdir -p /root/.ssh chown -R root:root /root/.ssh chmod 700 /root/.ssh chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys dhclient eth9 || true

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive dhclient eth9 || true apt-get update apt-get install -y openssh-server rsyslog dnsmasq tinyproxy iproute2 iputils-ping net-tools
# Crear usuario 'adminuser' (UID 1000) con sudo y clave publica autorizada id -u adminuser >/dev/null 2>&1 || (groupadd -g 1000 adminuser && useradd -m -u 1000 -g 1000 -s /bin/bash adminuser) echo 'adminuser ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/adminuser chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/adminuser mkdir -p /home/adminuser/.ssh cp /root/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/adminuser/.ssh/authorized_keys chown -R adminuser:adminuser /home/adminuser/.ssh chmod 700 /home/adminuser/.ssh chmod 600 /home/adminuser/.ssh/authorized_keys
# Configurar OpenSSH solo por clave publica mkdir -p /run/sshd sed -i 's/^#\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config sed -i 's/^#\?PubkeyAuthentication.*/PubkeyAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config sed -i 's/^#\?PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config systemctl enable ssh || true systemctl restart ssh || service ssh restart
# Configurar rsyslog para almacenar logs remotos de la VLAN mkdir -p /var/log/remotos chown syslog:adm /var/log/remotos 2>/dev/null || true systemctl enable rsyslog || true systemctl restart rsyslog || service rsyslog restart
# Activar DHCP en eth1 (VLAN 1000) para escalabilidad horizontal de Pods web con Multus systemctl enable dnsmasq || true systemctl restart dnsmasq || service dnsmasq restart
# Configurar tinyproxy en 10.1.2.101:8888 (permite instalar paquetes apt desde la VLAN # incluso cuando la NetworkPolicy default-deny bloquea Egress en eth0) grep -q "Allow 10.1.2.0/24" /etc/tinyproxy/tinyproxy.conf || echo "Allow 10.1.2.0/24" >> /etc/tinyproxy/tinyproxy.conf sed -i 's/^Listen.*/#Listen/' /etc/tinyproxy/tinyproxy.conf systemctl enable tinyproxy || true systemctl restart tinyproxy || service tinyproxy restart
